title: The Signature Counseling and Wellbeing Resources Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Student support services, access methods, and crisis-resource links. The Counseling and Wellbeing Resources Database records student support services with access methods: how to book counseling, what walk-in and group options exist, published crisis hotlines, and wellbeing programs such as stress workshops. Records are kept current and carry verification dates because this information must be right. The Signature side adds plain-language guides on what a first counseling visit is like.
